response_policy.factual_answers: Return answer verbatim from the matched record and display display_source.
response_policy.unknown_questions: Never synthesize admission facts; use the unknown_question response.
response_policy.time_sensitive_facts: Preserve admission_year and advise official-site verification for dates, fees, deadlines, and tentative schedules.

instant_response_design.ranking: exact question, alternative phrasing, category plus keyword overlap, then unknown

separation_rule: Only records with intent_type factual_faq may answer admission-fact questions; conversational records must not be used as factual sources.
